notes.text: The gallery is treated as a multi-object source. Its dynamically loaded sections must be expanded before inventorying entries. Gallery captions distinguish collection and acquisition dates from dates of making; those dates are not interchangeable. Individual linked IndiGen notes are separate authored sources when claims are extracted from them.

captures.note: Fully expanded capture preserving all eight gallery sections, 417 captions, museum numbers, embedded thumbnails and linked IndiGen notes.
